metadata.description: Shared Claude Code plugins for gocougs2020 repositories: the pull request review and fix workflow, and general web design and accessibility practices.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Drive a pull request to green: review and fix before each push, open drafts, mark ready once, let reviewers and Review Loop fix findings, and install Review Loop's GitHub workflows.

plugins.name: web-design
plugins.description: General web design, accessibility, and React/Next.js performance practices from Vercel, applied when building or reviewing UI.
